method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.finding: Official pinned data describe cloud optics as an example implementation. This README does not state the exact liquid generating PSD, RI, temperature or band averaging.
method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.inference: Authentic publisher bytes and compatible units do not supply a complete population/accuracy certificate.

method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.finding: The independent published method defines PSD integration and spectral averaging. Its stated LW source temperature for liquid is250K, and SW single-scattering albedo uses thick averaging with a solar spectrum.
method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.inference: It is not interchangeable with PR183 thin moment averaging and Planck5780/298.15K weights; reported flux agreement is not a certification of the original LUT.

method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.finding: The companion repository at the pinned commit imports miepython, offers thin/thick averaging, uses its own density and reference source definitions.
method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.inference: Potential PSD/band-integration cross-check, not an independent Mie kernel. Shared code must not be counted as two independent kernel references; this does not itself invalidate a component reference or add a new-kernel requirement. Match definitions and qualify uncertainty for the chosen claim.

method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.finding: Measurement uncertainty is evaluated from the measurement equation and instrument contributions.
method_facts_and_explicit_inferences.inference: Instrument/site uncertainty must accompany a matched observation; a generic instrument accuracy target is not a model error budget or a layer-heating-rate uncertainty.
